title: Cory Benfield - Building Protocol Libraries The Right Way - PyCon 2016
summary: Cory Benfield's PyCon 2016 talk on building protocol libraries that can be reused widely, using the Python Hyper HTTP project as the example. He argues for separating protocol parsing from I/O.
why: HN points to it as the foundational argument for sans-I/O protocol library design.

quote.text: give some really great brainfood about the way currently all kinds of network protocols are implemented
